headline: Guardrail sweep is 43 PASS / 10 FAIL / 1 NO-DATA, down from 15 red, and exactly one error-severity gate is left (check-token-paths-ratchet, 72 baselined). The pattern in every repair was the same: check what a red gate is actually measuring before fixing or deleting it. audit-component-integrity's --docs sub-check reported 0 of 104 components documented, which was not a coverage finding — it read 11 doc-site pages ADR-018 deleted, so zero was the only number it could return. Re-pointed at src/stories, coverage was really 101 of 104; the three genuine gaps (Card.Progress, Card.Metric, StackedCardRail) got stories rather than exemptions, so it is 104 of 104 and story-render went 442 -> 447. --tokens was flagging box-sx.test.ts for asserting that resolveSx turns width:100 into 100px — a spec is not a component. --api's 4 'breaking changes' were the already-released 0.13.0 surface (and one was a path move, not a removal), so the baseline was accepted with no changeset owed; its generatedAt was the literal string 'baseline', now the version it describes. check-token-rebake-needed is genuinely fixed this time: three generated files, not one, wrote unformatted output that lint-staged then reformatted, so they could never match by construction — all writes now go through scripts/lib/write-generated.mjs. validate-fixture-proof-of-firing is green at 54 of 54 after fixtures for check-code-connect, check-figma-coverage and check-figma-mapping, which exposed two real bugs: the Code Connect CLI was resolved from the fixture root, and generate-code-connect ignored FIXTURE_DIR and wrote to the real repo.
next: #249 — gate the record artifacts: a pre-push check so status.json and .changeset cannot silently go stale (5 changesets pending, CHANGELOG last touched 2026-07-10). The api-baseline drift found this week is the same failure mode, so fold it in
check-token-paths-ratchet is the last error-severity red: 72 baselined violations needing manual review before re-baselining. Everything else red is warn

check-link-integrity's 9 doc-refs are two different things: figma/model.json (4) is gitignored build output, so those references can never resolve in a clean checkout and need markers or a gitignore-aware gate; figma/snapshot.json (5) is blocked on #236
Tooltip (93:15) is the last unmapped Figma asset, on purpose: Figma publishes a Tooltip component, the code Tooltip is an @internal image-hover utility. Rename one side or accept the divergence
The push/drift/snapshot machinery (1441 lines, 89 tests) is complete and correct but has never run against Figma. Do not cut it — run the first push, then decide what earns its keep

ADR-025 states the Figma variables were 'edited by hand'. They were not: they were generated by the figma-agent-plugin sync-tokens tool, archived on archive/figma-bridge by ADR-018. Correct the ADR — it lowers the risk read on the first push from hand-work-vs-automation to two generations of the same tooling
